SFixture: John 3, in the words of the WEB
Pm
V1
TNow there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
V2
THe came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher who has come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”
Pm
V3
TJesus answered him,
W “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew,
FThe word translated “anew” here and in John 3:7 (ἄνωθεν) also means “again” and “from above”.
W he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”
Pm
V4
TNicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”
Pm
V5
TJesus answered,
W “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.
V6
WThat which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
V7
WDon’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must all be born anew.’
V8
WThe wind
FThe same Greek word (πνεῦμα) means wind, breath, and spirit.
W blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”
Pm
V9
TNicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”
Pm
V10
TJesus answered him,
W “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?
V11
WMost certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.
V12
WIf I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
V13
WNo one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
V14
WAs Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
V15
Wthat whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
V16
WFor God so loved the world, that he gave his only born
FThe phrase “only born” is from the Greek word “μονογενη”, which is sometimes translated “only begotten” or “one and only”.
W Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
V17
WFor God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
V18
WHe who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.
V19
WThis is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.
V20
WFor everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
V21
WBut he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”
Pm
V22
TAfter these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.
V23
TJohn also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;
V24
Tfor John was not yet thrown into prison.
V25
TTherefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.
V26
TThey came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”
Pm
V27
TJohn answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.
V28
TYou yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’
V29
THe who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.
V30
THe must increase, but I must decrease.
Pm
V31
T“He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.
V32
TWhat he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.
V33
THe who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.
V34
TFor he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.
V35
TThe Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
V36
TOne who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys
FThe same word can be translated “disobeys” or “disbelieves” in this context.
T the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”
